cryptographic_distinction_contract.hash_commitment: Provides non-repudiation and content integrity verification via SHA-256; does NOT provide confidentiality or access control.
cryptographic_distinction_contract.encryption: Provides payload confidentiality in transit and at rest; requires independent key management outside the agent runtime workspace.
cryptographic_distinction_contract.access_control: Provides authorization and physical/logical isolation boundaries; ensures candidate owner and executor cannot read sealed truth prior to adjudication.

independent_storage.requirement: Case Input and Sealed Truth must reside on physically or cryptographically separated storage boundaries.

hash_commitments.requirement: Record SHA256(CaseInput || Nonce) and SHA256(TruthManifest || Nonce) prior to execution authorization.

nonce_and_key_custody.requirement: Nonce and encryption keys must be held exclusively by the independent Custodian and never checked into repository.

zero_leakage_to_agent.requirement: The Coding Agent and Prompt Candidate Owner must receive zero plaintext truth or decryption keys.

post_freeze_disclosure.requirement: Truth is only disclosed to the Independent Adjudicator after all execution records are cryptographically frozen.
